name: Getting the Internship
description: Learn the roles, firms and dates, then build the CV, stories and habits that carry you through each round.

lessonNames.l4-firm-by-firm: What each firm's process looks like
lessonNames.l8-why-this-firm: Why this firm, why this role

lessonObjectives.l1-three-roles: Tell the three quant roles apart by their daily work and by what their interviews test.
lessonObjectives.l2-kinds-of-firm: Compare bank strats and research desks, hedge funds and trading firms as places to intern.
lessonObjectives.l3-the-calendar: Place each step of a summer internship cycle on a calendar, from postings in July to offers in winter.
lessonObjectives.l4-firm-by-firm: Read a firm's reported process and list the assessments and rounds to prepare for.
lessonObjectives.l5-a-target-list: Choose firms and roles that fit your track, region and timeline, including first-year and diversity programmes.
lessonObjectives.l6-one-page-cv: Write a one-page CV whose every line shows a skill an interviewer can test.
lessonObjectives.l7-projects-that-count: Turn a finished project into a CV entry and a two-minute account with numbers.
lessonObjectives.l8-why-this-firm: Answer "why trading" and "why us" with specific, true reasons.
lessonObjectives.l9-sitting-an-assessment: Prepare for proctoring, retake rules, timing and the environment before an assessment starts.
lessonObjectives.l10-recorded-video: Answer a recorded question in two minutes after thirty seconds of preparation.
lessonObjectives.l11-stories-that-answer: Build six stories in situation, task, action and result form that cover the common behavioural questions.
lessonObjectives.l12-reasoning-aloud: Narrate a solution so an interviewer can follow, check and steer it.
lessonObjectives.l13-the-final-round: Plan a final-round day: pacing, recovering from a bad round and the questions to ask.
lessonObjectives.l14-offers-and-deadlines: Handle an offer with a deadline, compare offers, and turn an internship into a return offer.
lessonObjectives.l15-after-a-rejection: Use feedback, reapplication waits and off-cycle roles after a rejection.
